description: This file defines the SimpleTextFragment class, which is a fragment used in an Android application to display simple text within a TextView. It handles argument processing to set text dynamically and provides methods to modify and retrieve the TextView.

classes.name: SimpleTextFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that displays a simple text message inside a TextView. It supports setting text via arguments or programmatically, suitable for tutorial or informational pages in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the view for the fragment by creating a TextView, setting gravity, and assigning text if available.

methods.name: getTextView
methods.description: Returns the current TextView object managed by this fragment.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Updates the text in the TextView using a string resource ID.

methods.name: processArguments
methods.description: Processes the arguments passed to the fragment to set the text or text resource ID accordingly.
